items.headline: Molecule acquires Trilogy Energy Solutions
items.summary: Molecule's ETRM platform gains deeper physical gas operations capability after acquiring Trilogy Energy Solutions, according to CTRM Center's vendor coverage.

items.headline: EMIR reconciliation deadline shifts to Sept 28
items.summary: Regulators reset the reconciliation start date for certain EMIR fields previously on a two-year timeline to 28 September 2026, while the underlying index name field reconciliation requirement was dropped, per Regnology.

items.headline: Transpacific spot rates jump, capacity pulled
items.summary: Drewry data cited by J.M. Rodgers shows Shanghai-Los Angeles rates climbing toward $7,185/FEU as carriers cut roughly 20% of capacity via blank sailings ahead of China's National Day peak.

items.headline: First Brands fallout renews trade finance scrutiny
items.summary: ITFA advisory board members are examining governance and transparency gaps in commodity trade finance exposed by the First Brands collapse, according to Commodity Trading Week's coverage.
